name: TwoTrees TTS-55
tagline: Ultra-budget diode with surprising build quality for the price
tldr: TwoTrees undercuts Atomstack and Ortur on price while offering a usable 5.5W–40W diode platform. Good for testing the hobby. Expect less polish, smaller community, and more variance unit-to-unit than established brands.
mainObjective: Lowest-cost bench laser for basic wood & leather engraving experiments

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Good companion if you already own TwoTrees 3D printers
cons: Open frame — full safety on you
May need alignment tweaks out of box
beginnerNotes: Only choose TTS-55 when every dollar counts. If you can reach $400–500, Ortur LM3 is a safer long-term bet.
proTips: Square the frame before first burn. Treat published max speed as aspirational — start at 50% for engraves until you dial settings in.
primaryUse: Bare-minimum budget diode for light engraving experiments and learning whether you enjoy the hobby.
